ps.en: When a [[senior]] designer named Wu lost her job, her long [[recovery]] began not with rest but with a plan. She wanted to [[solve]] a problem she had seen in every [[society]] she had lived in: waste. So she [[recruited|recruit]] a handful of neighbours and began to [[sell]] reusable goods door to door, then [[send]] them by post to strangers who cared.
ps.zh: 一位名叫吴的资深设计师失业后，她漫长的康复不是从休息开始，而是从一份计划开始。她想解决自己在住过的每个社会都见过的难题：浪费。于是她招募了几个邻居，开始挨家挨户卖可重复使用的物品，再寄给那些在乎这件事的陌生人。

ps.en: Wu was [[smart]] about it. A small, [[sociable]] team turned a quiet courtyard into a workshop where the [[smell]] of fresh ink mixed with rain that [[soaked|soak]] the canvas. They studied [[sociology]] and drew on ideas from [[socialism]] to build a [[social]] enterprise — one that measured success not in profit alone but in the homes it reached.
ps.zh: 吴在这件事上很机敏。一支好交际的小团队，把一个安静的院子变成了工坊，那里新鲜油墨的气味和着雨水浸湿了画布。他们研读社会学，并从社会主义里汲取理念，办起一家社会企业——衡量成功的不只是利润，还有它走进了哪些家庭。

ps.en: The real [[solution]] was a [[soluble]] package that dissolved in water and left nothing behind. Within a year the little brand began to [[soar]], and what had looked like a hobby became, in society's eyes, a model worth copying. Wu had not just [[recovered|recover]]; she had rebuilt a way of living.
ps.zh: 真正的解决办法，是一种溶于水、什么都不剩的可溶包装。不到一年，这个小品牌开始骤升，原本像爱好的事，在社会眼里成了值得效仿的样板。吴不只是康复了，她重建了一种活法。

ps.en: Inspector Zhao was a quiet man who liked to [[detach]] the noise of the city before a long case. He would sit in the [[shade]] of an old wall and let the [[shadow]] of the clock tower fall across his notes, then [[sort]] every clue by its [[source]]. A single [[detail]] could, he believed, [[detain]] a suspect for a night.
ps.zh: 赵督察是个安静的人，接手大案前喜欢先把城市的喧嚣抽离。他会坐在一面老墙的荫凉里，让钟楼的影子落在摊开的笔记上，再按来源把每条线索分类。他相信，一个细节就足以拘留一名嫌疑人一整夜。

ps.en: His method had one [[sound]] principle: suspicion is never proof. A [[sour]] colleague complained that Zhao was too slow, but Zhao held that a hasty arrest could cost an innocent [[soul]] its freedom. What gave him the [[advantage]] was patience, not force.
ps.zh: 他的方法有一条可靠的原则：怀疑从来不是证据。一位尖酸的同事故障他太慢，但赵认为，草率的逮捕会夺走一个无辜之魂的自由。让他占优势的，是耐心，而非强力。

ps.en: Zhao came to [[advise]] the younger officers that an [[advanced]] database was worth the cost. His [[advice]] was simple: to [[advance]] a stalled case you must first listen, and the advantage lay in patience. It was [[advisable]] to [[advocate]] for transparency, he said, even when no one else would.
ps.zh: 赵开始劝年轻警员，一套先进的数据库花得值。他的忠告很简单：要推进一起停滞的案件，得先倾听，优势在于耐心。即便无人响应，提倡透明也是可取的，他这么说。

ps.en: A [[colleague]] at an [[affiliate]] institute told Dr. Liang about a strange [[affair]]: the lab's records had begun to [[breach]] basic safety rules. What worried her most was not the rule itself but how a small [[break]] in procedure could [[breed]] a larger one.
ps.zh: 一家附属研究所的同事，告诉梁博士一桩怪事：实验室的记录开始违反基本安全规则。她最担心的不是规则本身，而是一条程序上的小小违反，会滋生出更大的违反。

ps.en: The [[breakdown]] of trust, she later said, seemed to [[coincide]] with a sudden cut in funding. An [[aesthetic]] sense of order had once [[affected|affect]] the whole team; now it was gone. She could not [[afford]] to stay silent, nor could she hide her [[affection]] for the place.
ps.zh: 她说，信任的崩塌，似乎与经费的骤减同时发生。一种对秩序的美感，曾影响整个团队；如今它消失了。她既不能对沉默负担得起，也无法隐藏对这片地方的爱。

ps.en: So Liang chose to [[affirm]] what the data showed, and the institute's reputation began to [[collapse]]. Yet from the [[brevity]] of the official report, she learned more than from any meeting. A colleague's loyalty, it turned out, had been the only thing that did not break.
ps.zh: 于是梁选择去肯定数据所显示的，而研究所的声誉开始崩塌。然而，从那份报告的简洁里，她学到的比任何会议都多。到头来，一位同事的忠诚，是唯一没有破裂的东西。

ps.en: A city [[committee]] was [[commissioned|commission]] to [[combat]] the rising cost of food. Its members began to [[collect]] stories from every district — a [[collection]] of small voices that, taken together, revealed a [[common]] fear. To [[command]] public trust, they first had to listen.
ps.zh: 市委员会受命应对不断上涨的物价。委员们开始从每个区收集故事——那是无数微弱声音的集合，放在一起，暴露出一种共同的恐惧。要想赢得公众信任，他们得先学会倾听。

ps.en: Opinions soon began to [[collide]]. A morning [[column]] in the paper [[commented|comment]] that [[commerce]] should not be slowed by rules, while a [[commercial]] grower warned that the crisis was real. The two sides had to [[combine]] their knowledge or fail.
ps.zh: 各种意见很快起了冲突。报纸上一篇晨间专栏评论说，不该让规则拖慢商业；一位商业种植户却警告说危机是真的。双方必须把自己的知识结合起来，否则就会失败。

ps.en: Volunteers who [[committed|commit]] their weekends to the cause were later [[commended|commend]] by the mayor. The committee treated each [[commodity]] as a shared resource, not a private good. In the end it was a [[collective]] effort — and a quiet proof that common sense still mattered.
ps.zh: 那些把周末投入进去的志愿者，后来受到了市长的称赞。委员会把每一件商品都当作共享资源，而非私产。最终，这是一次集体的努力——也是常识依然重要的安静证明。

ps.en: An old [[community]] centre, built in the years when [[communism]] shaped public life, decided to [[develop]] a small [[device]] that could [[detect]] unsafe air. The aim was simple: to [[communicate]] the results to every household before the evening news.
ps.zh: 一个老社区中心，建于共产主义塑造公共生活的年代，决定研发一个能测出空气是否安全的小装置。目的很简单：在晚间新闻前，把结果传达给每一户人家。

ps.en: The volunteers had to [[devise]] a plan that would [[deter]] the slow [[deterioration|deteriorate]] they had measured all winter. Good [[communication]], they found, did more than any warning sign. To [[ensure]] trust, they published the raw numbers online.
ps.zh: 志愿者们必须设计一套方案，以阻止他们整个冬天测到的缓慢恶化。他们发现，良好的沟通，比任何警示牌都管用。为了确保信任，他们把原始数据放到了网上。

ps.en: They needed to [[determine]] which street held the worst reading, a task that would [[entail]] months of work. [[Indeed|indeed]], the first map shocked the neighbours — but it also gave them a reason to act together, and a problem named is a problem halfway solved.
ps.zh: 他们需要查明哪条街的读数最差，这项任务需要数月的工作。确实，第一张地图震惊了邻居——但它也给了他们一起行动的理由；一个问题被命名，就等于解决了一半。

c: recover from illness 病后康复
recover one's composure 恢复镇定
recover lost data 恢复丢失的数据
words.dif: recover 强调失而复得；restore 强调归还原状，宾语多为物
words.pat: It took the region years to recover from the flood.
words.patZh: 这个地区花了数年才从洪灾中恢复。

words.dif: recovery 是名词恢复、痊愈；recover 是动词，二者常一起考
words.pat: A full recovery depends as much on rest as on medicine.
words.patZh: 彻底康复既靠药物，也靠休息。

c: recruit new members 招募新成员
words.dif: recruit 作动词表招募，作名词表新兵、新成员；enlist 侧重应征入伍
words.pat: The project recruited volunteers from across the city.
words.patZh: 该项目从全市招募志愿者。

c: sell at a loss 亏本出售
fam: sale n. 出售；廉价出售
words.dif: sell 的过去式、过去分词是 sold，是不规则变化，考试常考
words.pat: Products that tell a story tend to sell better.
words.patZh: 会讲故事的产品往往更好卖。

c: send sb abroad 派某人出国
send for a doctor 派人去请医生
words.dif: send 的过去式、过去分词是 sent；send for 表派人去叫，不是发送给
words.pat: The company sent samples to potential buyers overseas.
words.patZh: 公司把样品寄给了海外的潜在买家。

words.exam: 年长的；资格老的；地位较高的；毕业班学生
c: a senior engineer 资深工程师
senior to sb 比某人在职级上高
a senior student 毕业班学生
words.dif: senior 表年长、资深；junior 是反义；senior to 不用 than
words.pat: A senior colleague mentored her through the first difficult year.
words.patZh: 一位资深同事在她艰难的第一年给了她很多指导。

c: a smart decision 明智的决定
words.dif: smart 在口语常指机敏、时髦；intelligent 更正式，侧重智商高
words.pat: A smart strategy often beats a large budget.
words.patZh: 聪明的策略常常胜过庞大的预算。

words.exam: 气味；嗅觉；闻到；有某种气味
c: a pleasant smell 好闻的气味
fam: smelled / smelt（过去式） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: smell 泛指气味；scent 多指香气、踪迹；odor 偏臭味（美式）
words.pat: The workshop still smelled of fresh ink at midnight.
words.patZh: 半夜时分，车间里仍散发着新鲜油墨的气味。

c: soak up water 吸收水分
soak in the bath 泡澡
words.dif: soak 强调长时间浸泡、湿透；wet 是普通弄湿，程度轻
words.pat: Rain soaked the canvas before the team could pack it away.
words.patZh: 还没等团队收好，雨水就把画布浸透了。

c: soar to new heights 飙升至新高度
fam: soared（过去式） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: soar 原义高飞，引申为价格、数量骤升；rocket 也表骤升但更猛
words.pat: Demand for the product soared within a single year.
words.patZh: 短短一年内，该产品需求骤增。

c: a sociable person 好交际的人
sociable hours 适合社交的时段
friendly and sociable 友善合群
words.dif: sociable 指喜欢与人交往；social 指社会的、社交的，范围更广
words.pat: A sociable team is easier to keep together through hard times.
words.patZh: 一支合群的团队，在艰难时期更容易凝聚。

c: a social gathering 社交聚会
words.dif: social 修饰社会层面的；sociable 修饰人爱交际的，别混用
words.pat: A social enterprise measures success by the good it does, not only by profit.
words.patZh: 社会企业衡量成功，不只看利润，更看它带来的益处。

c: build socialism 建设社会主义
scientific socialism 科学社会主义
a shift toward socialism 向社会主义的转变
fam: socialist n./adj. 社会主义者；社会主义的
words.dif: socialism 是制度、思潮；communism 是更进一步的共产主义
words.pat: The cooperative drew on ideas from socialism to share its profits.
words.patZh: 这家合作社借鉴了社会主义的理念来分配利润。

c: a member of society 社会成员
words.dif: society 泛指社会；community 指具体社群、社区，范围更小
words.pat: What a society values most shows up in how it treats the weak.
words.patZh: 一个社会最看重什么，看它如何对待弱者便知。

words.dif: sociology 是研究社会的学科；society 是社会本身，词形相近易混
words.pat: Sociology helped the team understand why the neighbourhood changed.
words.patZh: 社会学帮团队理解了为何这个街坊会发生变化。

c: soluble in water 可溶于水
a soluble problem 可解决的问题
fam: solution n. 解决办法；溶解
words.dif: soluble 既可指可溶解的（化学），也可指可解决的（问题）；solve 是动词
words.pat: The package was designed to be fully soluble in warm water.
words.patZh: 这种包装被设计成在温水中完全溶解。

c: a solution to the problem 问题的解决办法
find a solution 找到对策
a solution of salt 盐溶液
fam: soluble adj. 可溶的；可解决的
words.dif: solution 是解决办法也是溶液；resolve 作动词表解决，别用混词性
words.pat: The real solution was not a new law but a change in habit.
words.patZh: 真正的解决办法不是新法律，而是习惯的改变。

c: solve a problem 解决问题
solve a mystery 解开谜团
fam: soluble adj. 可溶的；可解决的
words.dif: solve 宾语多为问题、谜题；resolve 还可接冲突、分歧，语义更宽
words.pat: She wanted to solve a problem she had seen in every city she lived in.
words.patZh: 她想解决一个在自己住过的每座城市都见过的难题。

c: a detached house 独立式住宅
fam: detached adj. 分离的；冷静的
words.dif: detach 强调从整体拆下、抽离；separate 泛指分开，不一定有拆的动作
words.pat: He liked to detach the noise of the city before a long case.
words.patZh: 他习惯在接手大案前，先把城市的喧嚣抽离出去。

c: pay attention to detail 注重细节
detail the plan 详述计划
fam: detain v. 拘留（形近易混）
words.dif: detail 是细节；detain 是拘留，两词形近但义远，阅读常设干扰
words.pat: A single detail can detain a suspect for a whole night.
words.patZh: 一个细节就足以让嫌疑人被拘留一整夜。

c: detain sb for questioning 拘留审问
detain a suspect 拘留嫌疑人
words.dif: detain 既指拘留也指耽搁；arrest 是逮捕，程度更重且正式
words.pat: Police may detain a suspect but must charge or release him soon.
words.patZh: 警方可以拘留嫌疑人，但须很快起诉或释放。

c: in the shadow of 在…的阴影下
cast a shadow 投下阴影
fam: shadowy adj. 朦胧的；可疑的
words.dif: shadow 强调光影里的暗影、阴影；shade 强调遮阴避暑的凉处，侧重点不同
words.pat: The shadow of the clock tower fell across his open notebook.
words.patZh: 钟楼的影子落在他摊开的笔记本上。

c: in the shade 在阴凉处
a shade of... 一点…（常用 a shade）
shade the eyes 遮眼遮阳
fam: shady adj. 背阴的；可疑的
words.dif: shade 指遮阳避暑的凉处；shadow 指物体投下的影子，二者常被一起考
words.pat: He sat in the shade of an old wall and let the city slow down.
words.patZh: 他坐在老墙的荫凉里，任由城市慢下来。

words.dif: sort 作动词是分类、整理；作名词是种类，与 kind 近义；sort out 是高频短语
words.pat: She would sort every clue by its true source before acting.
words.patZh: 行动前，她会把每条线索按真实来源分好类。

c: with all one's soul 全心全意地
words.dif: soul 偏灵魂、精神内核；spirit 偏精神、士气，二者常互换但侧重不同
words.pat: A hasty arrest could cost an innocent soul its freedom.
words.patZh: 草率的逮捕，可能让一个无辜的人失去自由。

words.exam: 声音；响声；健全的；可靠的；正确的
c: safe and sound 平安无恙
a sound argument 可靠的论证
fam: soundly adv. 健全地；熟睡地
words.dif: sound 作形容词表可靠的、正确的、健全的，极易被误读为声音；safe and sound 是固定搭配
words.pat: His method rested on one sound principle: suspicion is never proof.
words.patZh: 他的方法建立在一条可靠原则上：怀疑从来不等于证据。

c: a sour face 阴沉的脸
a sour comment 尖刻的评论
words.dif: sour 本义酸的，引申为尖酸、易怒的；bitter 侧重苦涩、愤懑
words.pat: A sour colleague complained that Zhao worked too slowly.
words.patZh: 一位尖酸的同事故障赵干得太慢。

words.dif: source 是源头、出处；resource 是资源，两词形近，考试常并列设题
words.pat: He sorted every clue by its source rather than by its appearance.
words.patZh: 他按线索的源头而非表象来分类。

words.exam: 促进；使未来事件提前发生；前进；进展
c: advance a cause 推进某项事业
words.dif: advance 作动词表推进、使提前；advanced 是其形容词先进的；advantage 是优势，别混
words.pat: To advance a stalled case you must first listen to both sides.
words.patZh: 要推进一起停滞的案件，必须先倾听双方。

c: advanced in years 年事已高
words.dif: advanced 表高级、先进；progressed 不单独这样用；developing 反义是 developed，不是 advanced
words.pat: An advanced database was worth the cost, he advised the young officers.
words.patZh: 他劝年轻警员：一套先进的数据库，花得值。

c: have the advantage over 比…占优势
a clear advantage 明显优势
words.dif: advantage 是优势、好处；take advantage of 表利用，也可含贬义占便宜
words.pat: What gave him the advantage was patience, not force.
words.patZh: 让他占据优势的，是耐心，而非强力。

c: give / offer advice 给出建议
a piece of advice 一条建议
follow one's advice 听从劝告
words.dif: advice 是不可数名词，不能说 an advice；advise 是动词，拼写差一个 s
words.pat: His advice was simple: listen first, then act.
words.patZh: 他的忠告很简单：先听，再做。

c: advise sb to do 建议某人做…
advise against 劝某人不要做
words.dif: advise 后接 sb to do 或 that 从句；advice 是名词，两词拼写只差 s，易错
words.pat: Zhao came to advise the younger officers on patient work.
words.patZh: 赵开始劝年轻警员，办案要有耐心。

c: it is advisable to do 做…是可取的
advisable for sb 对某人可取
words.dif: advisable 是明智可取的，常用于 it is advisable to do；没有 more advisable 这样的比较级
words.pat: It was advisable to advocate transparency even when unpopular.
words.patZh: 即便不受欢迎，提倡透明也是可取的。

words.exam: 拥护；提倡；主张；拥护者；提倡者
c: a strong advocate of …的坚定拥护者
words.dif: advocate 作动词提倡，作名词拥护者；与 advise（劝告）形近，注意区分
words.pat: He would advocate for transparency even when no one else would.
words.patZh: 即便无人响应，他也主张透明。

words.dif: aesthetic 是美学的、审美的；artistic 是艺术的，前者偏理论感受，后者偏创作
words.pat: An aesthetic sense of order had once affected the whole team.
words.patZh: 一种对秩序的美感，曾影响整个团队。

c: a public affair 公共事务
fam: affairs n. 事务（常用复数）
words.dif: affair 指事务、事件，复数 affairs 常指公共、国际事务；与 affect（影响）形近
words.pat: A strange affair at the lab began to breach basic safety rules.
words.patZh: 实验室里的一桩怪事，开始违反基本安全规则。

c: affect one's health 影响健康
words.dif: affect 是动词影响；effect 多为名词效果，作动词时表实现、引起，二者最易混
words.pat: An aesthetic sense of order had once affected the whole team.
words.patZh: 一种对秩序的美感，曾影响整个团队。

c: have affection for 对…有感情
win sb's affection 赢得某人的喜爱
a warm affection 温暖的感情
words.dif: affection 是喜爱、深情；affect 作动词感动、影响，名词 affection 不表影响
words.pat: She could not hide her affection for the place that raised her.
words.patZh: 她藏不住对这片养育了她的地方的感情。

words.exam: 使隶属（或附属）于；附属机构；分公司
c: a local affiliate 地方分公司
words.dif: affiliate 强调附属于更大机构；attach 是普通贴上、附加，语义更泛
words.pat: A colleague at an affiliate institute told her about the irregular records.
words.patZh: 一家附属研究所的同事，向她透露了那些不规范的记录。

c: affirm one's belief 坚定信念
affirm the finding 证实结论
words.dif: affirm 强调公开肯定、断言；confirm 强调核实后确认，二者语气不同
words.pat: Liang chose to affirm what the data clearly showed.
words.patZh: 梁选择去肯定数据清楚显示的事实。

words.exam: 担负得起；买得起；供给；给予
c: can't afford to do 负担不起做…
afford a house 买得起房
afford sb sth 给予某人某物
words.dif: afford 多用于 can / could 否定或疑问，表负担得起；supply 只是提供，无量力含义
words.pat: She could not afford to stay silent about what she had found.
words.patZh: 她无法对发现的一切保持沉默。

c: a breach of law 违法
words.dif: breach 比 break 更正式，专指违反（法律、合同、信任）；break 更口语化
words.pat: The lab's records had begun to breach basic safety rules.
words.patZh: 实验室的记录，开始违反基本安全规则。

words.exam: 打破；弄坏；打断；破坏；违反；休息时间
c: break a rule 违反规则
break the silence 打破沉默
a short break 短暂休息
words.dif: break 是多义核心词，可表打破、违反、休息；breach 是其正式同义替换，专指违反
words.pat: A small break in procedure can breed a larger one.
words.patZh: 程序上一处小小的违反，会滋生出更大的违反。

c: a nervous breakdown 精神崩溃
a breakdown of trust 信任的崩塌
fam: break down 出故障；崩溃（动词短语） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: breakdown 是名词崩溃、故障；break down 是动词短语，二者同源
words.pat: The breakdown of trust coincided with a sudden cut in funding.
words.patZh: 信任的崩塌，与经费的骤减同时发生。

c: a new breed of... 新型的…
fam: bred（过去式/分词） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: breed 本义繁殖、饲养，引申为酿成、产生（多指负面）；foster 偏培养正面
words.pat: A small break in procedure can breed a much larger one.
words.patZh: 一处小小的程序违规，会酿成更大的违规。

c: for the sake of brevity 为简洁起见
brevity of life 生命短暂
the brevity of the report 报告的简短
words.dif: brevity 是简洁（多赞）；shortness 是短，含不足意味，二者褒贬不同
words.pat: From the brevity of the report she learned more than from any meeting.
words.patZh: 从那份简短的报告里，她学到的比任何会议都多。

c: coincide in opinion 意见一致
words.dif: coincide 指时间、观点上的重合；correspond 指相对应、相符，搭配不同
words.pat: The breakdown of trust seemed to coincide with a cut in funding.
words.patZh: 信任的崩塌，似乎与经费削减同时发生。

words.dif: collapse 指突然倒塌、崩溃；decline 是逐渐衰退，程度与速度不同
words.pat: She affirmed the data, and the institute's reputation began to collapse.
words.patZh: 她证实了数据，而研究所的声誉开始崩塌。

c: a colleague at work 工作上的同事
colleagues and friends 同事朋友
fam: collegial adj. 同事般的；融洽的
words.dif: colleague 指同事、同僚，偏正式；coworker 更口语；partner 是搭档
words.pat: A colleague at an affiliate institute first told her about the affair.
words.patZh: 是一位附属研究所的同事，最先告诉她那桩事。

words.dif: collect 强调有目的收集；gather 泛指聚拢；compile 多指编纂
words.pat: Its members began to collect stories from every district.
words.patZh: 委员们开始从每个区收集故事。

c: a collection of... 一批…；一组…
a stamp collection 邮票收藏
words.dif: collection 是收集物、收藏品，常作 a collection of；collective 是集体的
words.pat: It was a collection of small voices that revealed a common fear.
words.patZh: 那是无数微弱声音的集合，暴露出一种共同的恐惧。

words.dif: collective 是集体的、共同的；作名词指集体，与 collection 不同
words.pat: In the end it was a collective effort that saved the programme.
words.patZh: 最终，是集体的努力救下了这个项目。

words.dif: collide 原义（车辆等）相撞，引申为（观点）冲突；clash 强调激烈交锋
words.pat: Opinions soon began to collide over how to act.
words.patZh: 关于该怎么做，各种意见很快起了冲突。

c: a newspaper column 报纸专栏
a column of smoke 一柱烟
words.dif: column 既指圆柱也指（报刊）专栏；pillar 也指柱子，但少指专栏
words.pat: A morning column in the paper commented on the new rules.
words.patZh: 报纸上的一篇晨间专栏，对新规作了评论。

c: combat climate change 应对气候变化
fam: combating（现在分词） n. 相关延伸
words.dif: combat 比 fight 正式，常接抽象对手（crime, poverty）；fight 更泛
words.pat: The committee was commissioned to combat rising food costs.
words.patZh: 委员会受命应对不断上涨的物价。

c: combine A with B 把 A 与 B 结合
words.dif: combine 强调合二为一、结合；connect 只是连接，未必融合；mix 偏混合
words.pat: The two sides had to combine their knowledge or fail.
words.patZh: 双方必须把自己的知识结合起来，否则就会失败。

c: command of English 对英语的掌握
command an army 统率军队
fam: commanding adj. 指挥的；居高临下的
words.dif: command 可表指挥（权）也可表掌握（语言）；order 只是命令，无掌握义
words.pat: To command public trust, they first had to listen.
words.patZh: 要想赢得公众信任，他们得先学会倾听。

c: commend sb for... 因…称赞某人
words.dif: commend 是称赞、嘉许，正式；recommend 是推荐，词义不同，易混拼写
words.pat: Volunteers who gave their weekends were later commended by the mayor.
words.patZh: 那些献出周末的志愿者，后来受到了市长的称赞。

c: a brief comment 简短的意见
words.dif: comment 泛指评论、意见；remark 也是评论，但更偏随口一说
words.pat: A morning column commented that commerce should not be slowed by rules.
words.patZh: 一篇晨间专栏评论说，不应让规则拖慢商业。

words.dif: commerce 是（大宗）商业、贸易，较正式；business 更日常生意
words.pat: A column commented that commerce should not be slowed by rules.
words.patZh: 有专栏评论说，不该让规则拖慢商业。

c: a TV commercial 电视广告
words.dif: commercial 作形容词商业的；作名词指（电视）广告，与 advertisement 近义
words.pat: A commercial grower warned that the crisis was real.
words.patZh: 一位商业种植户警告说，危机是真实的。

c: a commission to do 受委任做…
set up a commission 设立委员会
commission an artist 委托艺术家
words.dif: commission 既指委员会也指委任、委托；committee 只指委员会
words.pat: A city committee was commissioned to combat rising food costs.
words.patZh: 市委员会受命去应对不断上涨的物价。

words.dif: commit 后接 to do / to doing 表承诺、投入；committee（委员会）同源但义远
words.pat: Volunteers who committed their weekends earned the mayor's praise.
words.patZh: 那些把周末投入进去的志愿者，赢得了市长的称赞。

c: serve on a committee 担任委员
set up a committee 成立委员会
words.dif: committee 是为某事成立的委员会；commission 也指委员会，但更偏受委任的专门机构
words.pat: A city committee was commissioned to study the food crisis.
words.patZh: 市委员会受命研究这次食品危机。

c: a basic commodity 基本商品
a traded commodity 交易商品
words.dif: commodity 指（可交易的）商品、大宗商品；product 指制成品，goods 泛指货物
words.pat: The committee treated each commodity as a shared resource.
words.patZh: 委员会把每一件商品都当作共享资源。

c: a common goal 共同目标
fam: commons n. 公共用地；平民
communism n. 共产主义（同源）
words.dif: common 表共同的或普通的；mutual 只表相互的；ordinary 只表平常的
words.pat: In the end it was common sense that still mattered most.
words.patZh: 最终，最要紧的还是常识。

c: communicate a message 传达信息
communicate in English 用英语沟通
words.dif: communicate 强调双向交流、传达；convey 侧重单向传递（信息、情感）
words.pat: The aim was to communicate the results to every household in time.
words.patZh: 目的是及时把结果传达给每一户人家。

c: means of communication 交流方式
fam: communism n. 共产主义（同源）
words.dif: communication 是交流、通讯；commerce 是商业，二者形近易混
words.pat: Good communication did more than any warning sign could.
words.patZh: 良好的沟通，比任何警示牌都管用。

c: build communism 建设共产主义
under communism 在共产主义制度下
communism and socialism 共产主义与社会主义
fam: communist n./adj. 共产主义者；共产主义的
words.dif: communism 是共产主义（制度、思潮）；socialism 是社会主义，前者更进一步
words.pat: The centre was built in the years when communism shaped public life.
words.patZh: 这个中心建于共产主义塑造公共生活的年代。

c: a sense of community 社区归属感
the international community 国际社会
fam: communal adj. 公共的；公社的
words.dif: community 指具体社区、共同体；society 指抽象的大社会，范围更大
words.pat: An old community centre decided to develop a small device.
words.patZh: 一个老社区中心，决定研发一个小装置。

c: detect a problem 发现问题
words.dif: detect 强调通过迹象、仪器察觉、测出；discover 强调首次发现，语义不同
words.pat: The device could detect unsafe air before the evening news.
words.patZh: 这个装置能在晚间新闻前测出空气是否安全。

c: deter sb from doing 阻止某人做…
deter an attack 威慑攻击
fam: deterrent n. 威慑物；adj. 威慑的
words.dif: deter 是威慑、阻止；prevent 也是阻止，但 deter 强调吓阻、使之不敢
words.pat: They devised a plan that would deter the slow deterioration.
words.patZh: 他们设计了一套方案，以阻止缓慢的恶化。

words.dif: deteriorate 是恶化、退化，不及物；degenerate 也表退化，但多含道德堕落
words.pat: Good communication could deter the slow deterioration they had measured.
words.patZh: 良好的沟通，能阻止他们测到的缓慢恶化。

c: determine the cause 查明原因
words.dif: determine 可表决定也可表查明、确定（事实）；decide 只表做决定
words.pat: They needed to determine which street held the worst reading.
words.patZh: 他们需要查明哪条街的读数最差。

c: develop a plan 制定计划
develop a habit 养成习惯
fam: developed / developing adj. 发达 / 发展中
words.dif: develop 义项极多（发展、开发、养成、显影）；evolve 偏自然演化，不含制定
words.pat: The community decided to develop a small device for unsafe air.
words.patZh: 社区决定研发一个用于检测空气安全的小装置。

c: a safety device 安全装置
a mobile device 移动设备
leave sb to their own devices 任某人自行其是
words.dif: device 是装置、设备；devise 是动词设计、想出，二者形近，常被一起考
words.pat: They developed a small device that could detect unsafe air.
words.patZh: 他们研发了一个能测出空气是否安全的小装置。

c: devise a plan 设计计划
devise a method 想出办法
devise a strategy 制定策略
words.dif: devise 是动词设计、想出（办法）；device 是名词装置，拼写只差一个 e，最易混
words.pat: The volunteers had to devise a plan that would actually work.
words.patZh: 志愿者们必须设计出一个真正可行的方案。

words.dif: ensure 是确保（某事发生）；assure 是使（人）放心；insure 是投保，三词形近
words.pat: To ensure trust, they published the raw numbers online.
words.patZh: 为了确保信任，他们把原始数据放到了网上。

words.exam: 使（某事物）必要；牵涉；需要
c: what does it entail? 这需要什么？
words.dif: entail 强调必然带来、使必要；involve 只是涉及、包含，语气更弱
words.pat: The task would entail months of patient field work.
words.patZh: 这项任务，需要数月耐心的实地工作。

c: very good indeed 确实很好
not only... but... indeed 不仅…而且确实
fam: indeed 本身就是副词，无派生 n. 相关延伸
words.dif: indeed 用于加强语气或呼应 not only；truly 偏真实地，certainly 偏肯定地
words.pat: Indeed, the first map shocked the neighbours into acting.
words.patZh: 确实，第一张地图震惊了邻居，促使他们行动起来。
